properties.description:
SMWGUM

THE NATIONAL WEATHER SERVICE IN TIYAN GUAM HAS ISSUED A

* SPECIAL MARINE WARNING FOR...
GUAM COASTAL WATERS...

* UNTIL 715 PM CHST.

* AT 648 PM CHST...A SHOWER CAPABLE OF PRODUCING WATERSPOUTS WAS
LOCATED OVER EASTERN GUAM WATERS MOVING NORTH AT 30 KNOTS.

HAZARD...WATERSPOUTS AND WIND GUSTS 34 KNOTS OR GREATER.

SOURCE...RADAR.

IMPACT...WATERSPOUTS CAN CREATE LOCALLY HAZARDOUS SEAS. SMALL

CRAFT COULD BE DAMAGED IN BRIEFLY HIGHER WINDS AND

SUDDENLY HIGHER WAVES.

* THE SHOWER WILL REMAIN OVER MAINLY OPEN WATERS.

SEAS. SEEK SAFE HARBOR IMMEDIATELY.

properties.areaDesc: Straits of Florida from Halfmoon Shoal to 20 NM west of Dry Tortugas out 20 NM; Straits of Florida from Halfmoon Shoal to 20 NM west of Dry Tortugas 20 to 60 NM out
properties.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued October 18 at 4:48AM EDT by NWS Key West FL
properties.description:
The areas affected include...
Straits of Florida from Halfmoon Shoal to 20 nm west of Dry Tortugas
out 60 nm...

At 447 AM EDT, National Weather Service meteorologists detected a
strong thunderstorm, capable of producing wind gusts near 30 knots.
This thunderstorm was located 23 nm southeast of Tortugas Ecological
Reserve South, moving south at 10 knots.

The strong thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Prepare for thunderstorms with wind gusts near 30 knots, locally
rough and confused seas, occasional lightning strikes, and
potentially blinding downpours. Get to a safe port as quickly, and as
safely as possible. When downpours reduce visibility, slow down.

NWSheadline: A STRONG THUNDERSTORM SOUTHEAST OF THE DRY TORTUGAS

properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 18 at 12:59AM PDT until October 20 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves due to elevated
surf expected. Surf will build to 3 to 6 feet Sunday and persist
through Tuesday morning.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...From 9 AM PDT this morning through Tuesday morning.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk of ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can
wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor beach erosion and tidal overflows may
occur across south-facing beaches, especially in the Huntington
Beach area.
properties.instruction:
Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions, or
stay near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly
in such conditions, stay off the rocks.

properties.headline: Hazardous Seas Warning issued October 18 at 5:53PM ChST until October 19 at 5:00PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT...Very steep and hazardous seas 12 to 16 feet and southeast
winds 20 to 30 kt with occasional gusts to 40 kt.

* WHERE...Guam and Rota Coastal Waters.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM ChST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Very steep and hazardous seas could capsize or cause
damage to vessels.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Typhoon and tropical storm conditions are no
longer expected as Typhoon Champi continues moving away from the
region. However, combined seas will be very steep due to remnant
storm-induced swells and elevated wind waves. As Champi continues
moving away at a relatively quick speed, seas could drop below 15
feet after midnight.
properties.instruction:
A hazardous seas warning means hazardous sea conditions are
imminent or occurring. Recreational boaters should remain in
port...or take shelter until waves subside.  Commercial vessels
should prepare for rough seas and consider remaining in port or
taking shelter in port until hazardous seas subside.
